lines.text: Open a page: reads from shop.example, changes nothing.
Read a checkout: reads from shop.example, changes nothing.
Pay a checkout: moves money through shop.example. It pays out or charges.
Pay a checkout: every call waits for your approval, whatever a Card allows.
Pay a checkout: a Card's "Only for" can name which page it acts on.
Pay a checkout: counted in EUR, from what shop.example says the amount is, read as a decimal with up to 2 places.
Pay a checkout: shop.example doesn't say back what it used, so KIFF counts what the taf asked for.
Pay a checkout: if shop.example's answer is lost, you confirm whether it went through; until then it stays counted.
Pay a checkout: not tried with a test account, so you confirm its first 3 outcomes.
